8 days · Marrakech → Marrakech

Atlas Kasbah Sahara

The first stage starts with the Ouzoud Falls and crosses the High Atlas to the dunes of Erg Chebbi.

Request a booking
8 days
Marrakech → Marrakech
Riads + desert camp
4x4 with guide
  1. Day1

    Marrakech

    Arrival at Marrakech airport and transfer to the riad, 5 minutes from the famous Jemaa el Fna square.

  2. Day2

    Marrakech – Ouzoud Falls – Imilchil

    We start by visiting the Ouzoud Falls (a splendid 100-metre waterfall). Lunch. Afterwards we see the immense Bin el Ouidane lake, set in the magnificent scenery of the High Atlas. Arrival at Azilal, a small town high in the Atlas mountains. We continue to Imilchil, a Berber village famous for its customs: the girls of the Ait Hadiddou tribe traditionally choose their husbands. Overnight in a riad.

  3. Day3

    Imilchil – Amellago Gorge – Goulmima – Merzouga

    This journey reveals the magnificence of the High Atlas. We travel 150 km by track through the Berber villages of Agoudal, Ait Hani and Assoul. Lunch. We continue to the Amellago Gorge and, via Tadighoust, reach Goulmima. Then the road to Erfoud, surrounded by tamarisks and palm trees. Here the road ends and the desert tracks begin. We take one of them to the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi (Merzouga). Overnight at Riad Madu.

  4. Day4

    Merzouga – Erg Chebbi

    After breakfast we cover 130 km by track along the dunes: the two oases of Merzouga, the nomads, the village of Khamlia, the Mifiss mines, the desert plateaus and the Tissardmine oasis. Back around 3 p.m. Later we ride dromedaries into the heart of the dunes to watch the sunset. Overnight at the luxury tent camp in the middle of the desert.

  5. Day5

    Merzouga – Todra Gorge – Dades Gorge

    Visit to Rissani, the country's first imperial city, its great souk under the red arcades and its many ksour. We follow the road to Tinghir to visit the valley and the spectacular Todra Gorge. Lunch and asphalt road to the Dades Valley and its gorges. Overnight in a riad.

  6. Day6

    Dades – Valley of the Roses – Ait Benhaddou – Marrakech

    By road to Ouarzazate along the Route of a Thousand Kasbahs; we visit the kasbahs of Ait Benhaddou and Tamdakht. Then to Marrakech over the Tizi n'Tichka pass, with magnificent scenery and a wonderful contrast of colours. Overnight in a riad.

  7. Day7

    Marrakech

    Visit to Marrakech, the centre of Morocco: its medina, colourful souks, the famous Jemaa el Fna square, lively day and night, and its celebrated monuments: the Menara, the El Bahia and El Badi palaces, the Saadian tombs. Overnight in the same riad.

  8. Day8

    Transfer to the airport

    Breakfast and transfer to Marrakech airport.
